$comment: Mapping from O3DE Repo v0.0.0 (schemaless) to v1.0.0 schema

notes.description: v0.0.0 is the original schemaless format (no $schemaVersion field). v1.0.0 added explicit schema versioning and introduced the *_data aggregation pattern for embedding child object data.
dropped_in_v2: gems_data - aggregation of child gem data, violates OOP principles
projects_data - aggregation of child project data, violates OOP principles
templates_data - aggregation of child template data, violates OOP principles
engines_data - aggregation of child engine data, violates OOP principles
notes.design_notes: The *_data fields were an anti-pattern where parent objects described their children. In v2.0.0, each object is self-describing and repos only reference children via paths/URLs.

$schemaVersion.notes: Added in v1.0.0 - v0.0.0 had no schema version field

origin.notes: In v0/v1, origin was often conflated as a display name or short identifier. In v2.0.0, this becomes the author/owner structure

repo_uri.notes: In v0/v1, repo_uri was a raw content URL (e.g., raw.githubusercontent.com). In v2.0.0, this becomes source_control.git

gems_data.notes: Added in v1.0.0 - aggregates full gem.json data for all gems in the repo. DROPPED in v2.0.0 as it violates OOP by having parent describe children.

projects_data.notes: Added in v1.0.0 - aggregates full project.json data for all projects in the repo. DROPPED in v2.0.0 as it violates OOP by having parent describe children.

templates_data.notes: Added in v1.0.0 - aggregates full template.json data for all templates in the repo. DROPPED in v2.0.0 as it violates OOP by having parent describe children.

engines_data.notes: Added in v1.0.0 - aggregates full engine.json data for all engines in the repo. DROPPED in v2.0.0 as it violates OOP by having parent describe children.
